description: AI and automation capability improves faster than workforce and governance adaptation.
Tariffs export controls sanctions and regional standards fragment markets.
Insurance costs and physical risk change site selection and asset viability.
Stakeholder trust declines due to opacity labor issues data concerns or social harm.
Debt costs and investor caution constrain growth and transformation budgets.
Customers shift toward affordability sustainability privacy authenticity or responsibility.
Regulators increase enforcement around AI data platforms safety and competition.
Customers and institutions prefer regional resilient trusted suppliers and service providers.
